  • Classes in com.im.njams.sdk used by com.im.njams.sdk 
    Class Description
    AdditionalResources
    Builder for announcing additional project resources to the nJAMS server after the client has started.
    Njams.Feature
    Defines the standard set of optional features that an nJAMS client may support.
    NjamsArgos
    Owns Argos metric collector registration for an Njams client.
    NjamsCommands
    Owns the InstructionListener registry of an Njams client and handles the SDK built-in server commands (send-project-message, ping, replay, get-request-handler).
    NjamsConfiguration
    Owns the server-driven runtime Configuration of an Njams client (log mode, process exclusions, tracepoints) and its provider.
    NjamsFeatures
    Owns the optional-feature list and the container-mode flag of an Njams client.
    NjamsJobs
    Owns the registry of currently running Jobs of an Njams client.
    NjamsMetadata
    Owns the identifying metadata of an Njams client: path, category, versions, machine and session id.
    NjamsModel
    Owns the process models, taxonomy tree, images and process diagram tooling of an Njams client, and assembles and sends project messages.
    NjamsReplay
    Owns the ReplayHandler of an Njams client and processes replay instructions from the nJAMS server.
    NjamsSerializers
    Owns the Serializer registry of an Njams client and serializes arbitrary objects to strings for activity data.
    Path
    Represents an immutable nJAMS path node in a shared, lazily built path tree.
